{{Top|leg}}
'''Post Patrol''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] tactic used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Characteristics==
To reduce [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]], [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] and other illegal activities in a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] or [[Star system/Legends|system]], strong military forces were spontaneously stationed at [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] crossing points. These points could either be in deep space or at [[Spaceport/Legends|starports]]. At deep space points, [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruisers]] aided in dragging [[Starship/Legends|ships]] out of hyperspace.<ref name="AJ218">{{JournalCite|2|Rebel Privateers!}}</ref>

Every single ship encountered were thoroughly searched, [[Computer/Legends|computer]] records were examined and cross-checked while the crew underwent inspection. Errors in the procedure could lead to immediate arrest.<ref name="AJ218" /> Ships that tried to avoid or run the Post Patrol were engaged and either boarded or destroyed.<ref name="BoP">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter: Balance of Power Campaigns]]''</ref>

==History==
One such [[Battle near the Blair Cluster|Operation near the]] [[Blair Cluster/Legends|Blair Cluster]] was conducted by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Rage (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Rage'']] and the Interdictor cruiser ''[[Compellor/Legends|Compellor]]''. The results revealed that every ship stopped had been carrying wanted criminals, illicit goods, or both.<ref name="BoP" />
